reviews.title: Works great!
reviews.comment: I agree with the others, it comes shrink wrapped and wrinkled, but the trick of running it under warm water for a few minutes and massaging it back to shape works great.  It’s a perfect fit (snug) on my Elgato Wave3 microphone and does a good job of keeping out a chunk of the noise.  (I still get a PC fan hiss, but the noise reduction is more effective now with this.)  Very glad I picked it up.
reviews.author: John Slaughter

reviews.title: Great but had to cut hole in top to reach capacitive mute
reviews.comment: Great but had to cut hole in top to reach capacitive mute because if you put this on the associated microphone type it covers the capacitive mute function which is kind of annoying - easy fix is to just slit the top open a bit but it should come that way if it is going to be marketed for the Elgato Wave 3
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
